title: Greek Islands Batch 02 — Cyclades, Dodecanese, Sporades and Ionian Islands

placement_contract.location: Use map projection on source image geographic rectangle, not independent pixel scaling
placement_contract.z_order: above water and base terrain, below labels and standalone named landmarks
placement_contract.transparent_margin: kept within full image bbox; do not auto-trim PNG without updating bbox
placement_contract.labeling: No built-in geographic labels; avoid painting duplicate named settlements over island icons
placement_contract.off_map_rule: Skip if island not visible in final inset

qa_policy.geometry: GSHHS intermediate; preview shoreline must be checked against native Natural Earth land geometry before print
qa_policy.historical_buildings: decorative stylized until individual monument-specific 1095–1571 chronology passes
qa_policy.output_status: registration available; not yet composited into existing print pipeline

qa.historical_reviewer_notes: Kato Kastro, Chora fortified under Marinos Dandolos after 1207, per Cyclades Ephorate; leave pre-1207 variant unfortified.
Do not portray the post-medieval Panagia Tourliani monastery or iconic modern windmills as 12th-century features.
Ano Syros medieval settlement, but modern Ermoupoli buildings are NOT appropriate to 1097–1291.
Volcanic caldera coastal outline matches generalized intermediate GSHHS, not detailed individual harbor shorelines.
Chora has Middle Byzantine core; Venetian strengthening after 1206/07, later modifications should be phase-gated (Cyclades Ephorate).

Skaros castle is 13th century (1207–1265) per Cyclades Ephorate; for earlier phases depict a less developed settlement. The caldera is geographically preserved as land-only; Thirasia requires a separate sprite.
Monastery of St John was founded in 1088 (UNESCO); draw only a simplified fortified monastic core, not later 17th-century structures.
Querini hilltop Venetian castle is 15th century; generic older hilltop defensive symbolism only, revisit for late-phase depiction.
City and castle remain schematic; do not project Venetian-age skyline backward before its construction.
Need coastline period check for causeway/channel and modern Lefkada harbor; no precise town reconstruction.
